evals.prompt: Can you suggest visuals for the near-final fictional draft at evals/sample-process-draft.md (relative to the skill folder)?
evals.expected_output: A markdown brief with one hero image concept plus 1-3 supporting visuals (diagrams/illustrations, since the article has no hard numeric data), each with placement, concept, and rationale. Should not touch prose or discuss audience fit.

evals.prompt: What images should go with the short fictional draft at evals/short-draft.md (relative to the skill folder)?
evals.expected_output: A brief that is proportionate to a short, single-idea article -- likely just a hero image concept, or hero plus at most one lightweight supporting visual, not padded to hit a fixed count.
